title: [CI] run_test.py mutes test errors
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Without run_test.py:
```
$ python test/distributed/test_nvshmem_triton.py
... some failures

$ echo $?
1
```

With run_test.py:
```
$ python test/run_test.py --include distributed/test_nvshmem_triton.py
... some failures

$ echo $?
0
```

Example:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/17716027762/job/50342092319?pr=162529

Not sure if the muting of error is related to the "RERUN" feature in run_test.py.

### Versions

main

best_code:
$ python test/run_test.py --include distributed/test_nvshmem_triton.py
... some failures

$ echo $?
0
error_description: run_test.py returns exit code 0 even when tests fail, whereas running tests directly returns exit code 1 on failure. This effectively mutes test errors.
add_fix_code: # Distributed tests do not support rerun, see https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/162978
# ASAN tests are too slow, so running them x50 will cause the jobs to timeout after
# test every 2 weeks to satisfy the SQL query (15 x 14 = 210).
sub_fix_code: # Distributed tests are too slow, so running them x50 will cause the jobs to timeout after
# test every 2 weeks to satisfy the SQL query (15 x 14 = 210). The same logic applies
# to ASAN, which is also slow
count = 15 if is_distributed_test or TEST_WITH_ASAN else 50
